title: 검증 증거 정리와 smoke 재실행
summary: dirty/untracked evidence와 context의 Not run 상태가 서로 충돌하지 않도록 최신 검증을 다시 실행하고, upload -> preset -> generate real or mock -> result -> download/copy prompt 흐름 증거를 한곳에 정리한다.
acceptance: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm build` are rerun after TASK-009 and their latest pass/fail results are recorded without contradiction.
A local browser smoke verifies upload -> preset -> generate real or mock -> result -> download/copy prompt, including mock fallback if OPENAI_API_KEY or model access is unavailable.
Real OpenAI Image API attempt is recorded as success or as a specific failure reason without exposing secrets, if credentials are available in the environment.
Stale claims such as checks/review/evaluator being both pass and Not run are reconciled in loop state, release-readiness notes, and compressed context.
No .env value, OPENAI_API_KEY, uploaded private image, or sensitive generation payload is committed or logged.
modeContract: implementation: 로컬 실행과 smoke evidence 없이는 완료 선언 금지.
designContract: TASK-009의 first-screen generator evidence를 검증 증거에 포함한다.
evaluatorReason: Verification evidence is inconsistent and not trustworthy.
